build_mujoco_body_element: build a mujoco body XML element from a Blender object with position and quaternion
build_mujoco_light_element: build a mujoco light XML element from a Blender light object with shadows and attenuation
build_mujoco_mesh_geom: build mujoco geom XML elements from a Blender mesh object with materials
build_mujoco_joint: build a mujoco hinge joint XML element from a degree of freedom with axis and limits
export_blender_to_mujoco_xml: export a sequence of Blender scene objects to a mujoco worldbody XML tree
